chat.text:
Found: the shell hides an app it leaves with hidden = true (shell.js switchTo), and the Remote mount sets display flex on its own container (deskUnslothRemote.js mount, since goal/G14.4); an inline display beats hidden, so once the Remote has been opened it stays visible under every app.
The fix is three lines, all in the Remote: the flex column moves onto an inner wrapper, the container keeps no display of its own.

items.title: deskUnslothRemote stays visible over every app
items.box:
Andy, 2026-10-12, in the goal box: "This is NOT good, every panel in desk and desk details now shows the deskUnslothRemote. Needs fixing ASAP"; and "inder G18 is good. let's do that before anything else."

FOUND
- shell.js switchTo hides the app it leaves with _el.hidden = true; deskUnslothRemote.js mount sets container.style.display = flex (since goal/G14.4), and an inline display beats hidden, so the Remote stays visible under every app once opened.

THE FIX
- the flex column moves onto an inner wrapper; the container keeps no display of its own, so hidden hides it again.
